feel: Reduced textures, standard brightness, 125 fps cap

provenance.changes: 88 of 293 lines were left out: chat lines, passwords and logins, the player’s name, file paths and hardware details, server hosting settings, settings of other games, settings the game protects and scripts that need other files.

story: configs.eu lists this file under TEK9. The hardware it names suggests 2005 to 2008; the page gives no date. The second of two files published for this player. Sensitivity can’t be compared between players without the mouse’s DPI, which the file doesn’t give.
